mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for broader economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases by more than 5% YoY but SPX returns are negative over the next 20 days in 7 out of 10 cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 3.5% but SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of the next 5-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises by more than 0.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls, it indicates tightening monetary conditions and a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.5% and UNRATE decreases
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases by >0.5% and UNRATE decreases but SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% indicates increased economic activity and supply, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by >1% but SPX returns are negative over the next 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real state and local government finance (RSAFS) indicates increased government spending, which stimulates economic demand and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases by >2% YoY but SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of the next 20-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 3% indicates tighter monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 3% but SPX returns are positive in more than 40% of the next 5-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 100,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by >100k and UNRATE < 4% but SPX returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% indicates strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases by >2% but SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of the next 20-day windows.
